meta.title: Atlas - Supervised AI workflows for business
meta.description: Turn repetitive work into AI workflows you can copy, test, approve, and cost-track.

home.eyebrow: ATLAS OPERATING SYSTEM FOR REPETITIVE WORK
home.title: Turn repetitive work into workflows that actually run.
home.lead: Start with a proven template, connect the tools you already use, and let supervised AI handle the repetitive work. Every outbound action waits for human approval, and every step is recorded with visible cost.
home.canvasCaption: Execution Simulation: Inbound Lead Qualification (Run #281 • Rp 71 • Completed)
home.proofPillars: 120+ BUSINESS WORKFLOWS • CONTROLLED AI • REAL EXECUTION • VISIBLE COST • AUDITABLE RESULTS
home.stepsTitle: From concept to running in four steps
home.step1d: Start from 120+ battle-tested workflow templates ready to deploy, not a blank canvas.
home.step2d: Configure score thresholds, channels, and approval policies without writing code.
home.step3d: Run safe simulations to inspect every step and model cost before going live.
home.step4d: Monitor execution traces, human approval queues, and token spend in real-time.
home.controlBody: Customer messages, price quotes, and CRM updates pause at approval gates. Drafts are reviewed before sending.
home.costBody: Frugal model routing (such as GPT-5.6 Luna at ~Rp 18 per run) ensures predictable costs within monthly workspace ceilings.
home.traceBody: Every event is permanently and immutably logged in sequence. Trace model decisions, tokens, and response latencies down to the millisecond.
home.comparisonTitle: Why AI Chat Fails for Business Operations
home.comparisonSubtitle: Conversational chatbots are designed for open dialogue. Business operations require deterministic execution, human approval gates, and predictable budgets.
home.chatPoint1: Model hallucinations send directly to clients without safety nets
home.chatPoint2: Unstructured text outputs that cannot be reliably parsed into CRM
home.chatPoint3: Opaque and unpredictable token costs per business transaction
home.chatPoint4: Ephemeral chat logs without replayable audit trails
home.chatPoint5: Manual, one-by-one execution by staff members
home.wfPoint1: Mandatory human approval gate before any external message is sent
home.wfPoint2: Deterministic structured JSON schema validation at every DAG step
home.wfPoint3: Real-time cost accounting starting at ~Rp 18 per run via frugal routing
home.wfPoint4: Immutable append-only event audit logs recorded in sequence
home.wfPoint5: Autonomous multi-step execution with complete tenant isolation
home.agencySubtitle: Built for agencies and automation consultants. Build a workflow logic once, deploy it across dozens of isolated client workspaces.
home.agencyPoint1Body: Every client gets an isolated workspace bounded by server-side session checks.
home.agencyPoint2Body: Frugal model routing keeps platform costs at ~Rp 70 per run, enabling high-margin retainer pricing.
home.agencyPoint3Body: Rapid deployment for new clients in minutes using battle-tested templates across 12 industries.
home.industriesSubtitle: 10 dedicated production templates for every major industry vertical.
home.pricingTitle: Flexible Options for Every Business Need
home.pricingSubtitle: Use our self-serve SaaS platform or partner with our team for end-to-end turnkey implementation.
home.dfySprintDesc: Production-ready custom workflow delivered in 5 business days
home.dfyRetainerDesc: Ongoing monitoring, prompt tuning, and KPI maintenance
home.finalBody: Create a workspace, choose your industry template, and test an automated workflow in under 2 minutes.
home.honesty: Simulation mode today. Production connectors next. All workflows currently execute safely in an isolated sandbox with zero risk of accidental outbound dispatch or unintended mutations.

security.title: Security & trust
security.lead: What is actually implemented in this MVP, with no certification claims.
security.i1d: Every data query filters by the workspace from a signed session, never from browser input.
security.i2d: Passwords are never stored in plain text.
security.i3d: Template validation rejects external actions without an approval step.
security.i4d: Every side effect has a unique key so retries never duplicate actions.
security.i5d: FULL, REDACTED, or MINIMAL controls how much input content is kept in execution traces.
security.i6t: API keys stay on the server
security.i6d: AI provider credentials are read from server environment variables and never sent to the browser.
security.contact: Report security issues to the team via the contact page.
